Word List.say: Selam, ben Mikey! Bu liste kitaptaki kelimelerin hepsi. Kartları çevirip ezberleyelim!
Word List.title: Kelime listesi
text: Liste Revision 1, Revision 2 ve Theme 1 (School Life & Education) sayfalarındaki kelimelerden oluşuyor.
Her kartın önünde İngilizce kelime, arkasında Türkçe anlamı var. Hoparlöre dokunup telaffuzu dinleyebilirsin.
Word List.tip: Kelimeyi tek başına değil, bir cümlenin içinde öğren: "My uncle is very generous."

Word List.say: Fiiller ve kalıplar: cümle kurarken hep lazım.
Word List.title: Verbs and phrases

check.q: "He promised to come, but he ___ out."

Word List.title: Global citizens
Word List.tip: Not my cup of tea = bana göre değil. Think globally, act locally = küresel düşün, yerel davran.

People and Places.title: Kendini tanıt
f: I live in Berlin, the capital city.
I can speak German and English.
People and Places.tip: Ülke ve dil adları hep büyük harfle başlar: Japan, Japanese.

People and Places.say: Ülke, başkent ve dil üçlüsünü bilmek lazım.
People and Places.title: Countries, capitals, languages

check.q: İstanbul is the capital of Türkiye.

People and Places.say: Meslekler ve rutinler: hep geniş zaman!
People and Places.title: Jobs and routines
list: My mother works at a clinic. (Annem bir klinikte çalışır.)
My father develops software at an IT company.
She runs a clothing brand and travels abroad for work.
I usually walk to school and check my e-mails.
People and Places.tip: he/she/it ile fiile -s gelir: works, develops, runs, travels.

check.q: Where do you usually find a cooker?

Homes and Smart Houses.say: Akıllı ev ne yapar? Şimdiki zamanla anlatalım.
Homes and Smart Houses.title: Smart devices
list: A smart mirror shows the weather and reminds you of your schedule.
A robot hoover cleans the carpets automatically.
A voice assistant controls the lights, heating and doors.
What is the coffee machine doing? → It is making coffee.
Homes and Smart Houses.tip: "What is it doing?" sorusu şu anı sorar: It is + fiil-ing.

Homes and Smart Houses.title: Linking words
f: However / On the other hand → zıtlık (+ −)
list: Smart houses save energy. Moreover, they make life easier.
They are useful. However, they are expensive to install.

check.q: They provide security. ___, some devices are easy to hack.
check.why: Artıdan sonra eksi geldiği için zıtlık bağlacı.

Homes and Smart Houses.title: Writing plan
list: Title
Topic sentence: Smart houses are becoming more popular today.
2–3 advantages
2–3 disadvantages
Conclusion: your opinion
Homes and Smart Houses.tip: 100–150 kelime yaz; her avantaj ve dezavantajı bağlaçla bağla.

Types of Schools.title: Stages of education
f: nursery → primary school → lower secondary → upper secondary → university

Types of Schools.say: Dünyada pek çok okul türü var.
Types of Schools.title: Types of schools

check.q: Students live at school during term. Which school is it?

Types of Schools.title: Regular vs extracurricular
list: Regular: lessons, classwork, homework, quizzes, exams
Extracurricular: clubs, sports, music, volunteering, competitions
Types of Schools.tip: extracurricular = ders dışı. Bir kulübe katılmak: join a club / take part in a club.

check.q: Which sport uses a racket and a shuttlecock?
check.why: Badminton raket ve tüy topla oynanır.

School Life.say: Okulda kaygı ve stres: kelimeler ve çözümler.
School Life.title: Anxiety and stress
School Life.tip: Stresle başa çıkmak: plan yap, kısa molalar ver, rehber öğretmenle konuş.

School Life.title: Social language
list: Don't be in a rush at school! → Acele etme!
Don't skive off too often! → Okulu sık sık kırma!
Rise and shine for school, dear! → Hadi kalk, okul var!
Let's catch up during lunch time! → Öğle arasında buluşup sohbet edelim!
Don't miss the school bus! → Servisi kaçırma!

choices: miss school without a good reason

Present Simple & Continuous.say: İki zamanı karşılaştırıyoruz: rutin mi, şu an mı?
Present Simple & Continuous.title: Present Simple
f: Do you play…? / Does she play…?
I don't play / She doesn't play
text: Rutinleri, alışkanlıkları ve genel gerçekleri anlatır: The teacher explains the lesson every morning.
Present Simple & Continuous.tip: Zaman ifadeleri: every day, on Mondays, twice a week, usually, always.

Present Simple & Continuous.title: Present Continuous
f: I am studying. She is studying. They are studying.
Is he studying? / He isn't studying.
text: Şu an olan ya da geçici eylemleri anlatır: The students are discussing a project in the seminar room right now.
Present Simple & Continuous.tip: Zaman ifadeleri: now, right now, at the moment, today, Look!, Listen!

check.q: Look! The children ___ in the courtyard.

Present Simple & Continuous.title: Routine vs now
list: He usually plays football after school, but now he is preparing for the concert.
I train three times a week, but today I'm focusing on music.
Present Simple & Continuous.tip: know, like, want, need gibi durum fiilleri -ing almaz: I know (✓), I am knowing (✗).

check.why: like durum fiilidir: She likes chocolate.

Adverbs of Frequency.title: Word order
f: be + adverb: She is always on time.
adverb + verb: They usually walk to school.
list: How often do you go to the club? → Twice a week.
once, twice, three times a week / a month

Adverbs of Frequency.title: Never
Adverbs of Frequency.tip: Stres yönetimi rutini yaz: I always take short breaks. I sometimes listen to calm music.

Question Tags.say: "… değil mi?" demenin İngilizcesi: question tags!
Question Tags.title: How tags work
list: You are ready, aren't you?
She isn't leaving now, is she?
He usually plays badminton, doesn't he?
We can go to the music hall, can't we?
Question Tags.tip: Etikette yardımcı fiil + zamir kullanılır; isim değil: Ali is…, isn't he?

check.q: Your school has a big library, ___?

Must and Can't.title: Deductions
list: Her bag is still here. She must be in the locker room.
The headmaster can't be at school; he is attending a conference.

Must and Can't.title: Must vs mustn't
list: Deduction: He can't be hungry. He has just eaten.
Rule: You mustn't use your phone in class.

check.q: The music hall is full of noise. A band ___ be practising.
check.why: Ses var → bir grup prova yapıyor olmalı.

Object & Indefinite Pronouns.title: Object pronouns
list: She shows me something interesting in class.
Can you help us?

Object & Indefinite Pronouns.say: Şimdi belgisiz zamirler: some-, any-, no-, every-.
Object & Indefinite Pronouns.title: Indefinite pronouns

check.q: I don't know ___ about the trip.

Global Citizens.say: Roots and Routes: dünya vatandaşı olmak!
Global Citizens.title: What is a global citizen?
text: A global citizen understands the world, learns from other cultures, shares their own culture and works with others for a better world.

Global Citizens.title: Opportunities
list: Erasmus+: öğrenci ve öğretmen değişim projeleri
eTwinning: Avrupa'daki akranlarla çevrim içi projeler
Meslek lisesi öğrencileri için yurt dışı staj imkânları
Global Citizens.tip: Think globally, act locally: dünyayı düşün, çevrende harekete geç.

check.q: eTwinning helps students work on projects with peers in other countries.
check.why: Doğru, eTwinning uluslararası bir okul ağıdır.

Intonation.title: Examples
list: I really love our international school. ↘
Do you go to the robotics club? ↗
What do you usually do there? ↘
They help you relax, don't they? ↗

check.q: "Where is the canteen?" usually has ___ intonation.
